detail: Congregation’s building history records the 1839 nave, 1842 vestry, 1861 wings, 1895 fired-clay tower, raised roof and front ring wall, and the memorial unveiled in 1923.
Western Cape provincial list records the Dutch Reformed Church complex on Wellington Main Street as SAHRA 9/2/106/0004.
Mapped NGI spire-top survey point 3319-91 gives absolute elevation 161.6 m.
